unnamed_1: On February 28th, 2020, Season 33 of TAR halted production due to the COVID-19 pandemic. The season resumed in 2021, with obvious precaution taking, such as Team Will and Abby being automatically eliminated due to testing positive for the virus. The last four seasons of TAR have been directly impacted by COVID due to the inherent traveling and people-to-people interactions in every season, but these seasons have been notably different race-wise, which is what this sheet is dedicated to.
- The locations visited during the race has been significantly reduced for Seasons 33, 34, and 36, due to global travel restrictions.

unnamed_2: - Season 34 only raced in Europe and Jordan
- Season 36 only raced in Mexico, South America, and the Caribbean

unnamed_1: - Seasons 34 and 36 both started outside the USA, in Germany and Mexico, respectively.

- Seasons 33, 34, and 36 all featured the TAR Charter Plane, which took teams from 
location-to-location in between legs to avoid contact and spreading of the 
COVID-19 virus.
